description: This file contains server-side logic for handling the MCQ exam page in an online examination system. It loads questions from a database based on the selected course, displays multiple-choice questions, manages a timer, and records the user's answers and score into the database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing MCQ exam page, including question loading, timing, and result submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of questions from the database and setup of the exam timer.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on user's answers, stores results in database, and redirects to results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles expiry when time runs out.
